description: This file defines a Flutter ChangeNotifier called ContentDetailsController that manages the state of content details, including loading data from repositories, managing watchlist status, and caching. It interacts with ContentRepository, SimpleCache, and content models to provide state management for a content detail view.

classes.name: ContentDetailsState
classes.description: Enumeration representing the loading state of content details (loading, ready, notFound, error).

classes.name: ContentDetailsController
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages the state and interactions for content details, including loading content, managing watchlist, and persisting playback progress.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads content data from the repository, updates UI state, and handles errors.

methods.name: toggleWatchlist
methods.description: Adds or removes the current content from the user's watchlist and updates cache accordingly.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Reloads content data from cache without changing the UI state.

methods.name: recordPlaybackProgressSeconds
methods.description: Records the current playback position and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: recordPlaybackCompleted
methods.description: Marks the content as fully watched and resets progress.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes the cache listener and performs cleanup.
